climate: Merlot, Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Most rain falls in winter. Dry summers keep mildew and rot down, though young vines may need watering.

blurb.text: A region in the South West Australia area of Western Australia where Merlot leads plantings at 38 percent, ahead of Sauvignon Blanc (15) and Chardonnay (12).
